# Most followers on Instagram for a K-pop artist

Most followers on Instagram for a K-pop artist 

Who
:   Lisa

What
:   90,739,796 follower(s)

Where
:   Not Applicable

When
:   24 March 2023

BLACKPINK singer/rapper Lisa (Thailand, b. Pranpriya Manobal; @lalalalisa\_m) is the most followed K-pop star on Instagram, with 90,739,796 followers as of 24 March 2023. All four individual members of South Korea’s BLACKPINK have around 70 million followers on Instagram, while the group as a whole have racked up some 54 million followers.

While she’s ranked below female musicians like Selena Gomez, Ariana Grande and Beyoncé, Lisa has more followers than any K-pop act and more followers than any musician – male or female – outside the Americas. Her nearest rival, Dua Lipa, had 87,744,852 Instagram followers as of the same date.

# Top 17 K-Pop Idols on Instagram

Writer: Arthur S.
AJ Marketing - Top 17 K-Pop Idols on Instagram

K-pop has exploded from a South Korean craze in the early 2000s to a global phenomenon. Icons like BTS, Blackpink, and 2NE1 are topping the US Billboard charts and even lighting up stages at festivals like Coachella. Social media has been a game-changer in this rise. In South Korea, 24% of internet users follow influencers, 19.2% track actors and performers, and 12% follow bands and musicians (DataReportal). This online engagement keeps fans connected to their favorite idols' personal and professional moments, fueling K-pop's worldwide virality.

K-Pop idols hold significant influence in marketing, as fans seek to connect with their lifestyle and endorsed products. The trust and loyalty between idols and their fans extend to brands, making social media and influencer marketing top trends in South Korea. We've curated a list of the most-followed K-Pop idols on Instagram to help you effectively promote your brand in this market.

### Top 17 K-Pop Idols on Instagram ⬇️

AJ Marketing - Top 17 K-Pop Idols on Instagram - 1. Ranking

### 

## 17. Lay - EXO

Username: @layzhang

Followers: 13.5 million

AJ Marketing - Top 17 K-Pop Idols on Instagram - Lay

Let's talk about Lay Zhang, hands down one of the most famous K-Pop idols and a total superstar! This multi-talented icon is a rapper, singer, songwriter, record producer, dancer, actor, and entrepreneur all rolled into one. Evolving from EXO's dancer in 2012, he has now taken creative authority, storyboarding his own music videos and directing his cinematic album rollout, Flawed Crown. 

On social media, his Instagram grid is less like a celebrity billboard, allowing his audiences to look into his edgy, creative mind. He combines high-concept visuals with futuristic aesthetics and warm, humorous snippets from his life that somehow still feel human.

## 16. Hyuna

Username: @hyunah\_aa

Followers: About 15.3 million

AJ Marketing - Top 17 K-Pop Idols on Instagram - Hyuna

If you're looking for a solo artist who's not afraid to be daring, then look no further than Kim Hyun-ah, better known as Hyuna. She's a South Korean singer-songwriter, rapper, and model who first debuted as a member of the girl group Wonder Girls back in February 2007. But in 2010, she struck out on her own with a performance-oriented music style that has since won her a huge following.What keeps audiences refreshing her feed is not just her high fashion shoots or celeb glam, but how she blends them with bare-faced, unfiltered moments from her daily life. She is not afraid to be candid with her followers, sharing about how she is going through health struggles or performance exhaustion. This makes her one of the few idols who uses her platform as a living diary of someone navigating real life.

## 15. Yoona - Girls' Generation

Username: @yoona\_\_lim

Followers: About 18.5 million

AJ Marketing - Top 17 K-Pop Idols on Instagram - Yoona

If you're a fan of top K-Pop girl groups, you definitely know Yoona from Girls' Generation! She's not only a singer but also a talented actress from South Korea. Yoona debuted in August 2007 with Girls' Generation, one of South Korea's best-selling and most popular female groups, transitioning into a solo album and critically acclaimed television and film roles. 

On social media, she effortlessly shifts from sharing high-fashion editorial posts to simple lifestyle content such as baking treats at home and documenting her travels. These unscripted moments and personal milestones make her feed less stiff, balancing her star power with approachability.

## 14. BamBam - GOT7

Username: @bambam1a

Followers: 18 million

AJ Marketing - Top 17 K-Pop Idols on Instagram - BamBam [...] Jennie’s digital content often features artistic visuals that range from balletcore trends to casual street-style looks. She balances this high-glam aesthetic with a warm personality on her YouTube vlogs and TikTok posts, showing her real-life "Jendeukie" side, where she is known to be a soft-spoken and pet-loving persona by her audience.

## 1. Lisa - Blackpink

Username: @lalalalisa\_m

Followers: 106 million

AJ Marketing - Top 17 K-Pop Idols on Instagram - Lisa

Lisa, or Lalisa Manoban, the dancing queen of Blackpink, is one of the most famous K-pop idols. Her mesmerizing moves captivate fans worldwide. In September 2021, Lisa made her record-breaking solo debut with the album Lalisa, selling an impressive 736,000 copies in its first week. A true style icon, Lisa has collaborated with major brands like AIS, Samsung, Adidas, MAC, Bulgari, and Celine.

As one of the most followed Asian celebrities on Instagram, she effortlessly shifts between dramatic, high-glam posts to snapshots from her luxury travels. This sense of effortlessness makes her lifestyle appear completely natural and engaging.

## CONCLUSION

Instagram has become an essential marketing platform for K-Pop groups and solo artists. Instagram empowers fans to take a sneak peek into their idols' personal lives, and to take a look at their lifestyle outside the cameras and the stage lights. K-Pop idols also use this platform to truly connect with their loyal followers.Blackpink is a famous example of how to use Instagram to connect with fans, promote music, and share little glimpses of life beyond the spotlight. It's no surprise that all four members have snagged the top spots on the platform, engaging millions of followers worldwide.

Instagram's personal character humanizes K-Pop idols, making them more reachable and authentic to the public eye. The idols' posts allows fans to know how these artists live their lives, what they eat, what they use, and where they buy products. This is also why influencer marketing collaborations with K-Pop stars have risen as one of the best ways to promote a brand in South Korea.

We hope this list has helped you in your research on the top K-Pop idols you could work with on your campaign.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

##### Who are the most followed K-Pop idols on Instagram?

The most followed K-Pop idols on Instagram include BLACKPINK members Lisa, Jennie, Rosé, and Jisoo, along with BTS members like Jimin and RM. These idols have millions of followers due to their global fame.

##### Which K-Pop idols have the highest engagement on Instagram?

BLACKPINK’s Lisa and BTS’s Jimin are known for high engagement on Instagram, with their posts frequently receiving millions of likes and comments from fans worldwide.

##### How do K-Pop idols collaborate with brands on Instagram?

Instagram allows K-Pop idols to connect with their international fanbase, promote their music, and increase visibility through brand partnerships. The platform plays a key role in maintaining their public image and global reach.

##### Why are K-Pop influencers effective for brand marketing?

K-pop influencers are highly effective for brand marketing due to their massive global fanbases, high engagement rates, and ability to influence trends in fashion, beauty, and lifestyle. Their fans are loyal and responsive to their endorsements.

##### What are the best strategies for using K-Pop influencers marketing?

To maximize results, brands should focus on aligning their products with the K-pop influencer’s image and values. Using influencers for exclusive product launches, limited-edition collections, or global campaigns can create significant buzz.
